Description

A debt payoff tracker that shows the exact month you'll be debt free, opens in any browser, and never asks you to sign up for anything.

Debt Free Plan is one HTML file. You download it, double-click it, and it opens like a web page. Add your debts once, choose how much you can pay each month, and it builds your full payoff plan: what to pay on each debt this month, when each one is gone, and how much interest you save. Log payments as you go and watch every balance fall. No spreadsheet formulas, no bank login, no subscription. Your figures stay on your own computer.

How It Works:
1. Download the file and save it somewhere you will find it again.
2. Double-click to open it in your browser. Take the two-minute tour, or open Sample Mode to explore a set of fictional debts first.
3. Add each debt once: balance, interest rate, minimum payment and due day. Or import your card and loan downloads.
4. Choose your monthly budget and a strategy. Avalanche, snowball and three more are compared side by side.
5. Log payments as you go, or import your statements, and watch your debt-free date move closer.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:
• One HTML debt payoff tracker file
• Debt freedom dashboard: your debt-free date, total owed, paid so far and interest left to pay
• My debts as cards with a paid-off ring for each debt, or as a table; filter by category
• 5 payoff strategies compared at once: avalanche, snowball, cash flow first, credit score first, or your own order
• A monthly budget slider: watch the debt-free date and total interest move as you change it
• Month-by-month payoff schedule with interest and payment on each debt
• "Why not just the minimums?": the months and money your plan saves you
• What-if lab: an extra payment each month, a one-off payment (tax refund, bonus), a lower rate, a balance transfer with its fee, a consolidation loan, or "debt free by" a date you choose
• Pay this month: every payment, its due date, and a one-click "Log all as paid"
• Statement import for card, loan and bank downloads (CSV, OFX, QFX): payments, charges and real interest matched to each debt, duplicates skipped
• Each debt's own history, and balance updates from your statement any time
• Debt status: active, hardship plan, paused, in collections or in dispute
• Credit card minimums calculated the way card issuers do, and 0% promo periods that end on time
• Warnings when a balance is growing, a promo rate is ending, or a card is maxed out
• Progress coloring chart, milestones and a due-date calendar
• Find extra money: an optional budget and cut-back ideas to grow your monthly payment
• Every table sorts, searches and filters
• 8 color themes, light and dark; every screen prints
• Built-in how-to guide included

PERFECT FOR:
Paying off credit cards, store cards, car loans, student loans, personal loans, medical bills, buy now pay later, money owed to family, tax payment plans and mortgages. Anyone choosing between snowball and avalanche, couples paying off debt together, anyone leaving a messy debt spreadsheet behind, and anyone who wants their finances to stay private on their own computer.

Please note: this is a digital file, not a physical product. Nothing will be posted to you. Your data is stored in your own browser on your own device. This tracker never uploads anything anywhere. Download a backup regularly; the app reminds you, and Chrome and Edge can back up to a folder automatically every day. Interest is estimated monthly from the rate you enter, so your lender's statement may differ by a few cents; importing your statement brings in the real interest. Statement imports need the CSV, OFX or QFX download from your lender; PDF statements can't be read. Works best on a computer; phones and tablets can view and log payments. This is not financial advice.
